title: Client Demand: D-3 Deliverable Status — 11:07

fields.to: Client Liaison (SPO); Communications Lead (PIO); Incident Commander (IC)
fields.subject: UAS-11 – D-3 Deliverable Status – 11:07
fields.body:
SPO,

The client has issued a formal demand for a status update on Deliverable D-3 (calibrated hyperspectral cubes from the Lakeshore Flight Area summer campaign) by 12:00 today. The instrument (CP&L-D3) is tied to the collected data, and any delay in confirmation may trigger a contract default under Section 7.4.

The Payload Operator reported a position jump and loss of RTK fix during the flight window. PL-02 data (hyperspectral) may be corrupted due to uncommanded flight path changes and incomplete tarp deployment (CT-1 to CT-4 not visible). The forensic team has not yet verified data integrity.

Please confirm whether data was collected and whether it is usable. We must provide a clear status to the client by 12:00 to avoid a 10-day cure period or program suspension.

— CP&L Program Office
fields.signature:
CP&L Program Office
Office of the Assistant Director for Mission and Operations
Harwick UAS Operations Group | (585) 555-0177

instructorNote: This inject creates client deadline pressure. The team must decide whether to issue a public or internal update before 12:00, balancing data integrity risk against contract terms.
